maps.name: Varnfell
maps.description: Varnfell is a cold country between Hollowmere's dark woods and empty harbor and the great mountains far to the East. This massive continental landscape is home to many lost civilizations that all thought they would live forever.

maps.name: Hallowmere
maps.description: The last village on The Worm's Road. Slate roofs, shuttered windows, a chapel bell that still rings the dusk. Hollowmere has stood here since before the Auric Throne fell, and most of its folk would rather die in their gardens than be driven out by a wyrm.
